title: a bound successor future that is never awaited is a must-use error
purpose: A successor future carries the successor's obligation until it is awaited or handed on.

failure.justification: Statically visible loss is a semantic error; runtime discard checks remain defensive.

provenance.origin: authored for #754 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.1: a Future<^T> carries the successor obligation; a binding that leaves scope without awaiting or transferring it loses the successor (Book: await transfers a successor future's obligation to its result).
